name: clawsweeper
tagline: Hourly issue-triage bot for any GitHub repo.
what_it_does: Reviews open issues and PRs in a target repo, decides close/keep_open per item with structured reasons (already-implemented, cannot-reproduce, duplicate, not-actionable, stale-old). Conservative confidence gates plus per-item audit trail. 5 isolated workers running in parallel, modulo-partitioned by item number, idle ~99% of the time between hourly review cycles.

required_secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
required_secrets.purpose: Used by clawsweeper's gh CLI to enumerate issues/PRs and (optionally) write review proposals.

required_one_of.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
required_one_of.purpose: Codex CLI in API-key mode. Pay-per-token via your OpenAI account.

required_one_of.name: CODEX_AUTH_JSON
required_one_of.obtain_at: Run `codex login` locally, then paste ~/.codex/auth.json contents
required_one_of.purpose: Codex CLI in ChatGPT-auth mode. Uses your ChatGPT plan tokens.
required_one_of.orb_proxy_note: Codex hardcodes its ChatGPT-auth backend URL and ignores both openai_base_url and chatgpt_base_url config options. Traffic goes direct to chatgpt.com, bypassing ORB's LLM proxy. Sleep/wake/cost-per-second still work; LLM-call counter on the dashboard stays at 0.

required_inputs.name: TARGET_REPO
required_inputs.purpose: The GitHub repo whose issues + PRs should be reviewed.

optional_inputs.name: REPORT_REPO
optional_inputs.purpose: Where review proposals are committed as items/<n>.md. Defaults to the same repo.

optional_inputs.name: REPLICAS
optional_inputs.purpose: Number of parallel review workers. More replicas = more codex calls per hour but bounded by your rate limit.

optional_inputs.name: CRON_SCHEDULE
optional_inputs.purpose: When to fire each hourly review cycle. Default matches upstream clawsweeper.

optional_inputs.name: SWARM_NAME
optional_inputs.purpose: Identifier for this deploy. Used in DELETE /v1/swarms/<name> for teardown.
